translation: It is the same for the gentleman: the easy matter of seeking from oneself is truly the first good method of treating disease. For all the diseases of men and women, such as head wind, nasal discharge, toothache, ear swelling, beriberi, shank sores, pain of the sinews and bones of the hands, feet, waist, and back, and wind, cold, damp, heat, vacuity, weakness, soreness, and softness, at the si, wu, and wei hours of the three dog days, sun oneself naked in the blazing sun, regardless of new or old, large or small disease. In general, one can be completely cured and the root removed; even women's menstruation can be sunned. The spirit work of penetrating the transforming and nourishing of Heaven and Earth is hard to describe fully.
